memory_preflight_at_run.rule: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied pages) x page size >= concurrency x 2.75 GiB (the S47 launcher rule)

objective_convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost, contracted interface settlement EXCLUDED (Addendum 83 ruling 2); salvage reported separately; net = gross - terminal salvage

cell_report.objective_convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost, contracted interface settlement EXCLUDED (Addendum 83 ruling 2); salvage reported separately; net = gross - terminal salvage
cell_report.stopping_ratio_definition: rule ten: |Q[k] - Q[k-1]| / objective_tolerance at the last cycle (the record's rule_ten.terminal_step_over_threshold)

rho_read_back.rule: Addendum 86 ruling 2: per E2 cell, per cycle, per channel g in {v, pf, ess}, the recorded rho_g_after equals BITWISE sum([x] * n_g) / n_g in the canonical interpreter; x starts at S39_g x s and is carried across cycles from the recorded actions: increased -> x = min(max(x * 1.5, 1e-4), 1e4); decreased -> x = min(max(x * (1.0 / 1.5), 1e-4), 1e4) (production _scale_admm_penalty: value * factor, factor = 1.0 / decrease_factor); every factor-1 action (held, fixed, exempt (fixed), held after solver failure, held (frozen ...), any of them with " (exemption lifted)") keeps x; an unknown action refuses; n_v = n_pf = TSO + DSO blocks, n_ess = TSO + DSO + ESSO models (the record's solve_profile). A cell that does not reproduce bitwise is a harness-fault stop.

pre_launch_assertion.committed_holder_rule: E3 / E2: refused if held (key collision); screen: reported, never reused (no cost is carried across code states)
